meta.purpose: Futureproof stage demo. Seeds DataHub investment accounts and positions.
meta.key_note: ParentKey values are AbEntry-prefixed keys, matching how existing DataHub accounts in this tenant are parented. The demo engine manifest stores the same records with an Individual\t prefix; do not use those.
meta.position_note: Each position's ParentKey is a placeholder {{account_ref}}. Resolve it to the key returned when the account with that account_ref is created.
meta.id_note: New accounts use ACC-FP-nnn so they can be identified and rolled back separately from the existing ACC-DH-nnn set.
meta.data_note: All holdings are fictional. Fund descriptions and symbols follow Canadian statement format and are plausible but not verified against any real fund database. No figure represents real product performance.

2_scale_existing_accounts.applies_to: every account whose DATAHUB_ACCOUNT_ID starts with ACC-DH- that still exists after step 1
2_scale_existing_accounts.why: The 19 untouched households would otherwise sit an order of magnitude below the rebuilt ones and read as stale data. Run this BEFORE step 3; step 3 sets absolute cash values that must not then be doubled.
2_scale_existing_accounts.note: Positions under these accounts are not being rescaled, so position totals on the pre-existing ACC-DH accounts will no longer match their account market value. Tell Lewis if that matters to you and he will decide whether to rescale them too.
